title: Granular engine loading and lean Hybrid feasibility

definition.hypothesis: Avoid eagerly shipping software video decoders in a browser-video Hybrid runtime.
definition.scope_contract: PLAN.md; isolated builds and explicit browser trials only.
definition.baseline: Full Hybrid with matched link settings; shipping snapshot for metadata-only stripping.
definition.success_criteria: 20% lower gzip Hybrid bytes plus 10% and 100ms startup gain after bounded correctness.
definition.stop_criteria: Wrong output, lost fallback, or setup exceeding the bounded experiment.
definition.primary_metric: Compressed bytes and selection-to-verified startup milliseconds.
definition.negative_control: Wrong picture oracle; Firefox unsupported HEVC fallback.
definition.effort_limit: One pruned registry build, one strip candidate, targeted tests.

prepare.basis: Frozen runtime, matched identical baseline, build commands, hashes and synthetic/external fixture manifests.

screen.basis: Actual raw and gzip sizes recorded; decoder reachability dependency identified.

correctness.basis: Lean candidate failed Hybrid startup. Metadata-only candidate separately passed bounded v3 image and lifecycle checks; see REPORT.md.

performance.basis: Lean performance blocked by correctness. Separate metadata-only candidate completed 12 exploratory timing samples after its gate; no success criterion met.

results.basis: All failures and final variant-specific results preserved in REPORT.md and run evidence.

decision.basis: Stop registry-only lean profile; defer runtime codec modules; metadata stripping is a minor packaging follow-up only.

record.reason: Lean build fails playback despite 28.28% gzip reduction; metadata-only variant has 2.22% size reduction and no qualifying latency win.

next_action: Separate research proposal: browser decoder registration independent of FFmpeg software video entries, then repeat correctness before performance.
